findings.description: The reraise uses `from None`, which sets `__suppress_context__` and clears the `__cause__` on the underlying exception. Any original chain on the cause is hidden when it is raised.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the cause is itself chained (e.g. `raise ValueError from KeyError`) and TryAgain wraps it, then reraise=True. `from None` overwrites cause.__cause__ to None and suppresses the context, so the user loses the original chain in the traceback. Impact is only diagnostic information.
